in_hebrew.name: גלה
in_hebrew.meaning: היא שמחה או הודעה בשמי אלוהים
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם גלה הוא עברי ומשמעותו היא שמחה או הודעה בשמי אלוהים. הוא נגזר מהמילה 'גיל' שפירושה שמחה או התרגשות. השם גלה מופיע בתנ'ך כמטבע לשון המשלב שמחה והודיה לאלוהים. הוא משמש לעיתים קרובות בהקשר של ברכות והודיה.

in_greek.name: Γελία
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Γελία είναι ελληνικό και σημαίνει χαρά ή μήνυμα στον Θεό. Προέρχεται από την εβραϊκή λέξη 'גיל' που σημαίνει χαρά ή ενθουσιασμός. Στην Καινή Διαθήκη, παρόμοια ονόματα συνδέονται με έννοιες πνευματικής χαράς και μηνύματος από το Θεό.

in_latin.name: Gelia
in_latin.long_meaning: The name Gelia is derived from Hebrew origins, signifying joy or message to God. It stems from the word 'gil' meaning joy or excitement. In early Christian contexts, names similar to Gelia conveyed spiritual joy and divine messaging.

in_english.name: Gelya
in_english.long_meaning: The name Gelya originates from Hebrew roots, specifically from the word 'גיל' (gil), meaning joy or delight. Gelya symbolizes a personality that is cheerful, optimistic, and spiritually inclined. The name has been used across various Christian cultures, reflecting its universal appeal and timeless significance.

data.cultural_impact: The name Gelya has its roots in Greek mythology, where it referred to a nymph who provided milk and nourishment to the gods. This cultural legacy can inspire a sense of generosity, hospitality, and nurturing in those who bear the name. It may also evoke images of pastoral settings and idyllic landscapes, reflecting a connection to nature and the earth.
data.spiritual_significance: In Christianity, the name Gelya can take on a deeper meaning, symbolizing the spiritual nourishment and sustenance that comes from faith. Just as the nymph Gelya provided sustenance to the gods, so too does God provide for his people, nourishing them with his love, grace, and mercy. The name Gelya may also evoke images of the Blessed Virgin Mary, who nourished and cared for Jesus as a mother. Therefore, the name Gelya can serve as a reminder of the spiritual sustenance and companionship available to Christians through their faith.
